BrandHeritage.umbrella: Part of the Bagauri Bonds Georgia Group
BrandHeritage.title: Built on Trust. Engineered for the Future.
BrandHeritage.description: BBGeorgiaTech is the technology division of Bagauri Bonds Georgia — a company rooted in Georgian heritage, operating across Europe. We combine our parent company's commitment to lasting human relationships with cutting-edge web technology.
BrandHeritage.bondsDesc: We believe technology should connect, not complicate. Every website we build strengthens the bond between our clients and their customers — creating digital experiences that feel personal, professional, and built to last.
BrandHeritage.bagauriDesc: Georgia-born, globally minded. The name Bagauri represents our founder's heritage and the craftsmanship tradition we bring to every project. In a world of quick fixes, we build things that endure — and we invite you to build the next chapter of your digital story with us.

CoreCompetencies.service1Desc: From landing pages to complex web applications — we design and build custom websites that look stunning, load fast, and turn visitors into customers.
CoreCompetencies.service2Desc: Online stores built for performance. We create e-commerce experiences that are fast, secure, and optimized for sales — accessible to customers anywhere in the world.
CoreCompetencies.service3Desc: Your website is never done. We offer ongoing maintenance, security updates, content changes, and performance monitoring so you can focus on running your business.

ProcessSection.step1Desc: Free consultation and project scoping to understand your business goals.
ProcessSection.step2Desc: UI/UX mockups you approve before any code is written.
ProcessSection.step3Desc: Custom development, responsive formatting, and rigorous testing.
ProcessSection.step4Desc: Go live, followed by ongoing technical support and maintenance.

FAQSection.q1: How much does a new website cost?
FAQSection.a1: Building a custom website starts from $678, and our comprehensive maintenance packages start from $247 a year. Because every project is custom-tailored to your specific needs, please contact us for a free, precise quote.
FAQSection.a2: Yes. We offer comprehensive monthly support packages that cover hosting, security updates, and content changes so you don't have to worry about the technical details.
FAQSection.q3: How long does it take to build a website?
FAQSection.a3: A standard business website usually takes 3-4 weeks from discovery to launch, while complex e-commerce platforms may take longer.
FAQSection.q4: Do you work with international clients?
FAQSection.a4: Absolutely. While we have deep roots in Georgia and operate in France, we serve clients globally with seamless communication.

CookiePolicy.title: Cookie Policy
CookiePolicy.p1: We use standard HTTP cookies and browser LocalStorage to improve your experience on our website. A "cookie" is a small text file downloaded onto your device when you visit our site, allowing us to remember your preferences and understand how you use our services.
CookiePolicy.p2: These cookies are essential for the core functionality of our website. You cannot opt-out of these cookies as the site cannot function properly without them.
CookiePolicy.li1Desc: We store a small file in your browser to remember whether you have accepted our cookie banner.
CookiePolicy.li2Desc: We remember your preferred language (e.g., English, French, Georgian) to serve you the correct version of the site.
CookiePolicy.p3: With your consent, we use analytics cookies to measure website performance and understand how visitors interact with our content.
CookiePolicy.li3Desc: Used strictly to measure website loading speed and stability. No personally identifiable information is captured.
CookiePolicy.li4Desc: We use Google Analytics to understand traffic volumes and general geographic locations. Google sets its own cookies to distinguish unique visitors.
CookiePolicy.p4: You have full control over the data you provide to us. To manage your cookie preferences:
CookiePolicy.li5Desc: You can configure your browser to block or alert you about these cookies. Check the "Help" menu of your browser for instructions.
CookiePolicy.li6Desc: To prevent your data from being used by Google Analytics globally, you can install the official
CookiePolicy.li7Desc: You can clear your browser's cache at any time to reset your cookie preferences on our site.

PrivacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPolicy.p1: BBGeorgiaTech is committed to safeguarding your privacy. We collect minimal personal data strictly necessary for providing our services. The types of data we collect include:
PrivacyPolicy.li1Desc: Name, email address, and project details voluntarily submitted via our contact form.
PrivacyPolicy.li2Desc: Anonymized usage data collected via Google Analytics and Vercel to monitor website performance and user interaction.
PrivacyPolicy.p2: We process your data based on legitimate business interests and explicit consent. Your contact information is used exclusively to respond to inquiries and discuss your project. Usage data is aggregated to ensure our website remains fast and secure. We never sell, rent, or distribute your data to third parties.
PrivacyPolicy.p3: Contact form submissions are retained on secure mail servers only for the duration necessary to fulfill the inquiry or ongoing project requirements. Anonymized analytics data is retained in accordance with Google Analytics and Vercel data retention policies, typically rolling over after 14 months.
PrivacyPolicy.p4a: Under international data protection laws, including GDPR, you have specific rights regarding your personal information:
PrivacyPolicy.li3Desc: Request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
PrivacyPolicy.li5Desc: Request the complete deletion of your data from our systems.
PrivacyPolicy.p4b: To exercise these rights, please contact us at the email listed below.
PrivacyPolicy.p5: Our website is hosted on secure global networks. By using our services, you acknowledge that your data may be transferred, processed, and stored across international borders.
PrivacyPolicy.p6: For any inquiries regarding privacy or to exercise your rights, please contact us at:

ParadoxOfScale.title: Our Philosophy
ParadoxOfScale.quote: Simplicity is the key to brilliance.
ParadoxOfScale.p1: We don't do mass production. Every project gets our full attention, our best thinking, and our highest standard of craftsmanship. Quality over quantity — always.
ParadoxOfScale.p2: By focusing on what truly matters, we create websites that feel fast, intuitive, and purposeful. No bloat, no unnecessary complexity — just clean, powerful digital experiences that serve your business goals.
ParadoxOfScale.author: — Bruce Lee
